svg.title: Two ways to feed events
svg.desc: Timeline comparison: the Simulator fires a scenario file's events at their times; exercise_sim_events sends an events file one event at a time, each after the previous one is handled.

g.text: Fires every event whose time has passed, on the 50 ms update; does not wait for anything; clock starts when Dispatch is STOPPED and consistent.

g.text: Starts the next event only when the previous one is handled: the service answered and, with wait_for_job_completion, its job is SUCCESS or ERROR.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Each event goes to /sim/enqueue_garage_event with time 0, so sim_world fires it on its next update.

g.text: Two ways to feed events: timed and sequential

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: A scenario file's events are fired by the Simulator at fixed times. An events file is fed one event at a time by exercise_sim_events, which waits for each job and writes per-event metrics.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Batch configurations pair one scenario with one or more events files.
